evidence.scope: Independent cross-task duplication, composition, regression, spec-split and architecture/dependency assumption review only; no re-litigation of in-task judgments.
evidence.inputs: Read complete T14, T15 and T16 packets, their complete current audit artifacts including history, approved shared-400-validation-completion spec (Rules 5–6 / F1 F2 / #198 AC), phase-5 index, example phase-pass-phase-4.json shape, and all three supplied diff ranges. Current task verdicts are REVIEW_PASS and each reviewed_sha equals its DONE task's done_sha.
composition: T14, T15 and T16 own disjoint files (agent/my-work/sse/helpers vs auth vs client/src/api.test.ts). Later ranges do not rewrite earlier-task files. T14's three behavior commits plus test-only correction remain intact after T15/T16.

T14 makes workspaceIdParam the single workspace-id schema: lenient parseWorkspaceId and helpers re-export deleted; parseWorkspaceIdValue removed; settings parseWorkspaceId stays a thin parseWith(workspaceIdParam) delegate from prior work. legacyIntegerParam is unused for workspace ids and remains only for non-workspace ids (board/thread/attachment/card). Combined member/invite positiveIdParam messages in workspace-params.ts are packet-excluded legacy combined checks, not a second workspace-id implementation.

T15 consumes T5 auth-schemas without touching T14 parsers: one USERNAME_MESSAGE (ASCII hyphen-minus) is shared by register and oauth set-username. No EN DASH remains in non-doc source. T16 pins that exact ASCII string plus T14's workspaceId / Invalid params bodies and Phase 4 fieldErrors through public api methods that call throwRequestError; client source is unchanged.

Client URL builders type workspaceId as number; EventSource paths interpolate numeric workspace ids; my-work client parsers already require digits-only > 0. T14's isolated tightening (0/-1/1e2/space/abc/unsafe) therefore does not meet a lenient client sender. Notifications Number() after requireWorkspaceMember is post-validation coercion, not a leftover lenient parser.

Rule 5–6 scenarios assigned to this phase are covered across the split: strict workspace matrix + Invalid params split (T14), oauth/register wording identity (T15), throwRequestError + workspace-id client audit + PR/issue drafts (T16). No cross-task duplicate parser or message constant. PR-5 file count is 20 (T14 15 + T15 4 + T16 1).
